messages:
Maya Chen: Heads up — noticed a sustained bump in GPU-hours for the last 12h in eu-west. Dashboard shows cluster throughput stable but token counts doubled for a subset of customers. Suspect duplicate retries from the ingest pipeline. https://dash.redwood.internal/d/p/usage?panel=gpu_hours :eyes:

Liam O'Neill: @Maya can you paste the raw query you used? I want to check if this is from the gpu_meter or the batch-aggregator. Also did anything deploy to ingestion yesterday?

Maya Chen: Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hr, sum(gpu_seconds) AS gpu_secs, count(distinct request_id) AS reqs
FROM usage.events_agg
WHERE region = 'eu-west' AND ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
GROUP BY hr
ORDER BY hr;
```
Sample rows showed a couple of hours where gpu_secs spiked x2 while reqs only +20%.

eng-bot: Alert: ingest-aggregator-retries > 5% for pipeline=eu-ingest (history: 07:12 -> 12:46). Ticket created: INF-3981

Sophie Patel: Linking the spike to a backfill job might make sense — we had backfill-worker v2 rolled out last week. I also see increased kafka consumer lag in the same window. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/p/kafka_lag?var-topic=usage-events

Ram Gupta: Network note: on 2026-03-10 there were transient egress throttles from the eu-west subnet, packet drops caused retries in our client lib. Those retries are exponential but we recently removed dedupe on retries in the backfill. Could cause double-counting on gpu_seconds if a job is reprocessed.

Liam O'Neill: Quick triage plan:
1) Pause non-urgent backfills in eu-west (toggle feature flag)
2) Re-enable dedupe on backfill-worker v2 (hotfix)
3) Run dedupe pass on the aggregator for the spike window (SQL below)
4) Ramp autoscale cap to 150% for 2h to keep latency SLOs while we investigate

Dedupe SQL (run on analytics readonly):
```sql
DELETE FROM usage.events_agg_deduped
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-09' AND '2026-03-11'
AND request_id IN (
  SELECT request_id FROM usage.events_agg GROUP BY request_id HAVING count(*) > 1
);
```

Maya Chen: I paused backfills, put up a doc in #eng-infra-runbook for the hotfix steps, and notified oncall. Latency improved slightly after throttling backfills. :thumbsup:

Sophie Patel: I'll add a dashboard panel that shows gpu_seconds per unique request_id to catch this earlier. Also propose an alert: gpu_secs / unique_reqs > 1.8 for 30m -> create INC alert.

Ram Gupta: I'll look into the network egress policy and file a change to increase socket queue and retry jitter for the clients.

Liam O'Neill: Sounds good. Postmortem items: root cause (egress throttles + dedupe removal), short term mitigation (pause backfills, hotfix, dedupe pass), long term (better alerting, client-side jitter, backfill safety gates). I'll own the postmortem.

Maya Chen: Thanks all — marking INF-3981 as in-progress and will update when the dedupe job completes.

eng-bot: INF-3981 status changed -> in_progress (assignee: Liam O'Neill)

Sophie Patel: Quick note for docs: add a metric definition to the infra glossary for gpu_seconds vs gpu_seconds_per_unique_request and include sampling guidance.

Maya Chen: Agreed — adding to the roadmap for next sprint. Closing the immediate thread but keeping follow-ups in INF-3981.
